title: Escape continuity across hand transfer and explicit cancellation on real drop
acceptance_criteria: Hand transfer requires current custody before commit and a fresh current snapshot afterward, never currency of the stale old locator; the original escape ID/start tick survives through original-body completion.
Successful real manual drop explicitly cancels that body's escape before same-tick living-body re-pickup; denied drops, internal hand transfer and escape completion do not self-cancel.
Required native dead-airlock fixture establishes loaded physical doorway overlap after medical death and preserves capture, original UUID retention and paid reopen assertions.
Analyzer canonical state/species/portraits, exact cursor-source reconciliation, ambient fixture cadence and smooth camera regressions remain green.
Fresh focused JVM, full native, affected readiness, isolated client startup and packaging pass; connected GPU/input acceptance remains manual.
manual_steps: Repeatedly transfer an escaping AI mouse between hands: the five-second attempt should finish. A real drop/re-pickup should interrupt the old attempt.
Drag the mouse icon under the cursor until escape: it should clear without a checkerboard or phantom drop. Check an unchanged normal item drag.
Scan healthy, critical and dead mice for state, Mouse species and matching portrait; compare Human/Pig and confirm held-camera smoothness.
